sources.shootings: NYC Open Data, NYPD Shootings (2006–Present) (5ucz-vwe8), with fatalities from NYPD Shooting Victims (pztn-9bne)
sources.subway: MTA / NY State Open Data, MTA Subway Stations (39hk-dx4f) and MTA Subway Service Lines (s692-irgq)
sources.bus: MTA / NY State Open Data, MTA Bus Routes (bzwk-3hb4), routes currently in effect
sources.evictions: NYC Open Data, Evictions (6z8x-wfk4) — residential, executed
sources.education: NYC Dept. of City Planning, Facilities Database (ji82-xba5): schools, day care and pre-K, after-school programs
sources.food: NYS Dept. of Agriculture and Markets, Retail Food Stores (9a8c-vfzj)

_prov.method: Each layer is clipped to the SD-20 boundary (points kept if inside; subway and bus lines clipped just past the border). Shootings are one dot per incident, not per victim; an incident is fatal if any victim in NYPD's victim file is flagged a murder. NYPD updates the shootings files quarterly.
_prov.caveats: Points are shown at the location the agency recorded. NYPD places most shootings at the midpoint of a street segment, so dots are approximate and several incidents can share one spot. Records without usable coordinates are counted below, not guessed. Precinct lines are not district lines. Subway lines are colored by MTA trunk line; bus segments show routes passing through, not full routes.
